Vaulto
Launched this week
Turn voice notes into text, tasks and reminders

1 follower

Visit website
Record a thought and turn it into editable text, tasks and reminders on Android. Whisper and Qwen run on your phone after model download. Local notes, transcription and AI are free, without an account. Optional Pro adds cloud processing and sync. The mobile client is GPLv3; the hosted backend is separate. Model downloads take storage, and speed depends on your phone.
